q10_justification: The post-war setting is entirely civilian: colonization, farming, governance by elected council. Graff becomes Minister of Colonization.

q12_justification: The bugger world has different seasons, unfamiliar flora and fauna, and alien-built infrastructure, but is fundamentally habitable with adaptation.
